facts.business: OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited is an integrated contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) offering multi-modality capabilities across biologics, complex injectables (including drug-device combinations), sterile injectables, and oral soft gelatin technologies.
key_risks: Impairment of Goodwill and related Cash Generating Unit (CGU) involving significant assumptions on future sales growth, operating costs, terminal growth rates, and weighted average cost of capital
